title: TRUE or FALSE: GTA 6 facts that sound fake #gta6 #shorts
description: Character switching per IGN/GameRant reports; original 2025 window per Rockstar's first trailer.

scenes.say: These GTA 6 facts sound fake. Are they?

scenes.question: You can swap between Jason and Lucia
scenes.say: You can switch between Jason and Lucia while exploring. True or false?

scenes.question: You can swap between Jason and Lucia
scenes.say: True. You can swap between the two leads in the open world.

scenes.question: GTA 6 was first set for 2025
scenes.say: GTA 6 was originally supposed to launch in twenty twenty five. True or false?

scenes.question: GTA 6 was first set for 2025
scenes.say: True. The first trailer said twenty twenty five, then it got delayed twice.
